privacy_policy: Educational IDs, conditions, ordered tokens and opaque complete snapshot hashes only. No raw SQL question rows, timestamps, credentials, runtime identity or progress.

review_summary.null_policy: Preserve the existing absent technical filter. Exclude unselected questions on exact-bound unsaved matching clones, not by changing stored levels.
review_summary.boundary: Finite educational target, not a general grammar analyzer. Ukrainian conditions constrain meaning and order; other grammatical constructions outside those conditions are not declared ungrammatical. Other levels are scope-excluded only, without a claim of semantic review.

clone_only_policy: All original attributes/answers/options/hints/pivots must match. Only the displayed Ukrainian condition is replaced on clones. Case/multiplicity use unchanged native code. Full fallback for unknown/stale input.
